summary: Acer Aspire 15 A15-41M System State Baseline
detected_fault: mshidkmdf.sys driver acting as an in-between for HID devices and KMDF, potentially causing BSODs due to compatibility issues or misconfiguration.
suggested_solution: Update BIOS to latest version, disable power saving for HID devices and USBs in the Device Manager, consider reinstalling Windows on a new SSD, and monitor CPU TDP settings
